integrity: All-size proofs use an exact nonnegative local bond identity, path-parity bounds and explicit equality cases; two independent finite computation programs only corroborate the proof. Historical priority may be limited by unindexed equivalent work.
scientific_limitations: Classical uniform-coupling spin-one wheel graphs at strictly zero magnetic field and zero temperature; no finite-temperature or nonzero-field diagram, and no thermodynamic-limit phase transition is asserted.
title: Parity-controlled vacancy condensation in antiferromagnetic spin-one wheel graphs
